title: Refund holdout for repeat claimants
already_ships: Brand X logged 10000 claims at a 12% refund-abuse rate, about €2.5M annual loss on the claims-cancel journey.

options.title: Keep the queue
options.summary: Leave the existing refund queue and static rule unchanged for this quarter.

options.title: Holdout + policy
options.summary: Ship a holdout on refund policy changes and measure net margin before scaling.

devils_advocate.why_fails: Holdout may starve a market of refunds and spike NPS complaints in week one.
devils_advocate.who_loses: Good customers who need a legitimate refund during the holdout window.
devils_advocate.cannot_measure: True fraudster displacement will not show in ninety days of one brand.
devils_advocate.why_not_live_control: The static repeat-claimant rule already covers the loudest pattern.

recommendation.argument: The locked outcome is a Finance-grade savings proof; only a holdout produces that proof.
